summary: Deployment health smoke test for CrackerPOS. All 14 backend tests passed: /api/openapi.json (200 JSON) and /api/docs (Swagger) work; /api/products returns the list with no _id; login and /auth/me return the right role for admin1, admin2, retail, wholesale (pending) and salesperson; a retail cash order lowers stock by 1 and can be fetched with GET; /api/admin/stats returns 200 for admin, 403 for retail and salesperson, and 401 for anonymous users. Frontend home page loads 8 product cards and category chips with no broken images.
critical_code_review_comments: seed() is env-only for admin passwords now, as expected. Admins are seeded only when no admin exists, and entries with a missing env var are skipped quietly. Consider logging a warning when ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD are missing.
The demo retail and wholesale users are still seeded with hardcoded password 'demo1234'. Consider whether this is acceptable in production.
server.py is over 2200 lines. Consider splitting it into routers.
The anonymous home page logs two expected 401 console errors from the auth/me and refresh probes. These are harmless.
Supervisor shows the 'mobile' program FATAL. It is not part of this app and is probably unrelated.
seed_data_creation: One retail cash order of qty 1 was created by demo@crackerpos.in, which lowered one product's stock by 1. No passwords were changed and no data was deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smoke suite: tests/test_deploy_smoke.py. Credentials are in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Auth uses an access_token cookie or a Bearer token. Login is rate-limited to 5 failures per IP.
